scenarios.name: Orders sandbox operations
scenarios.summary: A fictional operations team inspects supplied evidence for its orders workload and hands over restart and delivery-review records. The orders release vocabulary, releases/orders.zip and rev-42 come from the glossary. AWS targets and identity contexts remain the supplied approved contexts; nothing is executed or provisioned. Authored table observations are fictional, not real-world facts.

assets.title: Orders restart: operator handover
assets.description: Read-only fictional established procedure for a bounded restart. These authored rows are a teaching example, not instructions for a provisioned service. Every action has a checkable expected result and a stop/escalation path; no additional recovery action is authorized.

columns.name: action_order
columns.description: Ordinal execution order, not a resource identifier.

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: Known operational outcome of the complete procedure.

columns.name: preconditions
columns.description: Conditions required before beginning routine execution.

columns.name: approved_action
columns.description: Action from this fictional established procedure.

columns.name: expected_result
columns.description: Observable result to check before advancing.

columns.name: failure_handling
columns.description: Bounded response if the expected result is absent.

columns.name: escalation_recipient
columns.description: Operational owner who takes over; not an individual person.

assets.title: Orders delivery: review-handoff evidence
assets.description: Read-only authored fictional comparison records. Minutes are illustrative measured values, not glossary-prescribed targets or real-world findings. Each row keeps the same measure before and after one bounded handoff change. The three separate cases permit improved, unchanged and worsened judgments without implying that the change always works.

columns.name: case_id
columns.description: Distinct fictional comparison case; not a quantity.

columns.name: review_handoff_evidence
columns.description: Supplied observation supporting the selected bottleneck.

columns.name: selected_bottleneck
columns.description: Delivery stage supported by the observation.

columns.name: bounded_change
columns.description: One change scoped only to the review handoff.

columns.name: success_signal
columns.description: Identical measure used in both observations.

columns.name: expected_outcome
columns.description: Direction of the intended measurable outcome; no invented numerical target.

columns.name: baseline_minutes
columns.description: Observed baseline for the named success signal.

columns.name: after_change_minutes
columns.description: Observed after-change value for the same success signal.
